title: A2A Containment Action
description: Risk-tiered containment request/response envelope, issued during the `act` phase in response to a detected security event. A three-tier risk model drives escalation: Low is auto-contained end-to-end; Medium/High auto-contain immediately at the access layer (ZTNA) but require human approval before pushing config changes to a Vendor Core (e.g. an ACL push via a2a-ceos-core / a2a-junos-core).

trace_id.description: Unique identifier correlating this action across the init/observe/act/report lifecycle, and used to reference a pending approval (e.g. for a later deploy/rollback call).

risk.description: Risk tier assigned to the detected event. Low: access-layer containment only, fully automatic. Medium: access-layer containment automatic, Vendor Core config push requires approval. High: access-layer containment automatic, Vendor Core config push requires approval, and an account/global lock may additionally be proposed.

src_ip.description: Source IP address associated with the detected event.

username.description: Associated account identifier, if applicable. Lockout tracking is keyed on username, not src_ip, so that other users sharing an IP are unaffected.

event_summary.description: Opaque context from the detection source (e.g. process/binary name, event count) used both for risk explanation and for audit.

deploy.description: Whether to also push the resulting configuration change to a Vendor Core (e.g. ACL isolation), versus access-layer containment only.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the escalation, typically generated from event_summary. Falls back to a templated explanation if generation fails.

results.description: Per-layer containment outcomes for this action, e.g. { "ztna": {...}, "vendor_core": {...} }. Populated according to the risk tier's response plan.

ztna.description: Result of the access-layer containment step (e.g. revoke, drop_block, lock).

vendor_core.description: Result of the Vendor Core config push (e.g. ACL isolation), if deploy was approved and executed.

status.description: Current state of this containment action. `approval_required` corresponds to a pending Vendor Core config push awaiting human approval; `rolled_back` indicates a previously deployed containment action was reverted.

audit_log.description: Reference to (or inline copy of) the corresponding append-only audit trail entry.
